# Anne & Bertha Shirley

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Child of — [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During the drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne.md) resolves to enjoy the journey despite her dread of being sent away. Asked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to share her true background, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her life as an orphan, describing her parents' deaths and her childhood moving between homes and looking after children before being sent to the asylum. Listening to Anne's history, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for the neglected child and considers whether they should keep her after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a pleasant two weeks visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) while being courted by Phil's suitors. She visits her childhood home and meets the current owner, who gives her a packet of old love letters written by her deceased parents. After visiting her parents' graves in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to read the letters, feeling deeply connected to her mother and father at last.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday
